items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: Buddy Pity Band. And the time I was in Buddy Pity Band, they had one song around here that I used to sing pretty good in the band.

ctx.x: I never didn't know his other name. Some people called him Louie Nelson too. His real name was Deleal though, Louie Deleal, but his father had called him Louie Nelson for some reason. I think the big guy told me his father had worked with some people called Nelson when he was a boy. A lot of people just called him Nelson then. But that's one reason Bunker always called Louie Nelson. The trombone is called Dr. Nelson's son because of the other big guy. His name was Well, I never didn't know much about him. In…
Buddy Pity Band. And the time I was in Buddy Pity Band, they had one song around here that I used to sing pretty good in the band. It was a song you called Tight Like That.
Oh yeah, sure. The record came out about that time. Yeah. Well, from then on I ... Louie Armstrong made a record of that too, yeah.
